welcome.title: Welcome to Chatvia
welcome.intro: Let's create your first AI agent. It only takes a minute.
welcome.what_body: An agent is an AI assistant you train on your own content. It answers your customers on your website, chat widget, and messaging apps.
welcome.how_body: First you create an agent and give it a name. Then you train it with your files, websites, and text so it can answer questions.
